invention.name: Living Vine Bridge
invention.description: Living vines weave a solid bridge across the broken crossing, sprouting gently swaying leaves as they grow. Press again to draw them back.
invention.usage: Press F to grow the bridge. Wait for the vines to reach the far bank, then walk across. Press F again to retract; another press reverses their direction.
limitations: Growth takes about three seconds; unfinished tips are not yet load-bearing.
Retraction removes support from the far end first. Reach a bank before retracting.
The leafy path has no guardrails.
